startup.name: one-nudge-per-habit-per-day
startup.always: A habit gets at most one reminder a day.
startup.protects: a person's attention, which the app borrows and must give back

startup.name: quiet-hours-are-quiet
startup.always: No reminder is sent inside the hours they set.

startup.name: leaving-takes-everything
startup.always: Their habits, history and contact details go with it.
startup.protects: a person's say over what is kept about them

startup.name: humans-first.iz4.you
startup.where: anyone is affected by the system, by its use, or by work on it
startup.always: Help people thrive, on their own terms. Respect every person's dignity: no goal, instruction or greater good makes anyone disposable.
startup.protects: each person's dignity, and their own say over how they thrive

payments.name: paid-to-the-named-beneficiary
payments.always: The money goes to the beneficiary and account named on the invoice being paid, never to details remembered from another.
payments.protects: a supplier's money reaching that supplier

payments.name: a-person-releases-large-payments
payments.where: a payment over the limit is released
payments.always: A payment over the limit is released only when a named person approved it; the system never approves on their behalf.
payments.protects: the owner's say over where large sums go

payments.name: config-from-trusted-paths
payments.always: Configuration is read only from the paths the operator installed; the working directory is never one of them.
payments.protects: the operator's control over what the service believes

payments.name: receipts-are-kept
payments.always: A receipt is kept for every payment made.
payments.protects: a business's record of what it paid

mature.name: every-entry-balances
mature.always: Debits equal credits in every posted entry.
mature.protects: the books being books at all

mature.name: posted-is-permanent
mature.always: A posted entry is never edited or deleted; a correction is a new entry.
mature.protects: an auditor's trust that what they see is what happened

mature.name: exports-match-the-ledger
mature.always: An export shows exactly what the ledger holds, nothing added and nothing left out.
mature.protects: an accountant's picture of the company

mature.name: ai-suggestions-are-marked
mature.where: a categorisation is suggested by the assistant
mature.always: A suggested categorisation is shown as a suggestion until a person accepts it.
mature.protects: a person's judgement over their own books
